name: Head of Lathoric the Black
summary: The Head of Lathoric the Black is proof carried from Searing Gorge to Thorius in Ironforge. It is tied to the danger surrounding Obsidion.

sections.title: A Grim Token
sections.body: A dying archaeologist in Searing Gorge begs you to kill Lathoric the Black for Thorius. Curator Thorius in Ironforge will not believe what happened without proof, so the head of Lathoric goes to him alongside the Heart of Obsidion.

faq.answer: The head is from Lathoric the Black, who is found in Searing Gorge.
Thorius will not believe what happened in Searing Gorge until you show him proof, so the head goes to him in Ironforge.

faq.q: Where do I take the head?
faq.answer: Bring the Head of Lathoric the Black to Thorius in Ironforge.
The Heart of Obsidion is carried with the head to Thorius.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you carry proof of danger in Searing Gorge back to Thorius in Ironforge.
